Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Runner Rug, 2' 10" x 7' 10", Grey and Taupe
Materials: polyester
Upgrade your hallway or other narrow floor space with this beautiful rug. With a classic geometric pattern updated to suit modern tastes, this rug is a perfect addition to transitional-style home décor, and its taupe and gray tones will blend well with most color themes. 2'10"W x 7'10"L Imported. 49% polyester, 29% polypropylene, 16% jute, 6% cotton Machine made with a textured geometric pattern Medium .39" pile suits any indoor space Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
